newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Petroleum and mineral resources ministry will offer a mumber of investment opportunities in the mineral sector to local and international investors.
- Saudi businessmen set up a $50 million company to promote investments in the former republics of Central Asia.
- Two British nurses accused of killing their Australian colleague offer financial settlement to the victim's brother.
- Saudi Chevron signs a 1.14 billion riyal loan agreement with a group of banks.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed sends three planes to pick up Lebanese stranded in Sierra Leone.
